top_signals.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
top_signals.summary: The open-source AI coding project OpenCode has notified a small number of users that API keys they used with external providers were exposed in a security breach. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
